assets.prompt: EDIT TARGET / STYLE LOCK: use the attached game background's kelp silhouettes as the only style reference. Produce an animation sprite sheet of the same dark blue PIXEL ART kelp, NOT illustrated plants. Eight frames in a precise 4 columns by 2 rows equal grid. Each frame is a 48 by 48 logical-pixel sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbour scaling, every pixel hard square, 5 flat dark navy/teal colors only, no gradients, no glows, no fine veins, no painterly texture, no realism. Simple but well shaped organic stepped silhouettes like the reference. Same plant anchored bottom-center, sways gently over an eight-frame cycle, no camera or scale changes. Transparent background, lots of padding so each equal cell can be cropped by the browser. No ground, no letters, no grid lines, no labels. Preserve the reference's actual low-resolution pixel-art language.

Edit the attached PIXEL ART game background into a distinct deeper biome. LOCK THE EXISTING ART STYLE EXACTLY: preserve the hard stepped pixel edges, flat 4-color rock faces, dark blue palette, sparse dithering and low-resolution sprites. Do not add detail, painterly shading, realistic textures, volumetric effects, castles or elaborate carvings. Replace the rounded blue boulders with darker angular obsidian walls that taper toward an open central chasm; a few small amber crystal pixel clusters replace cyan clusters, and purple pixels replace pink ones. Remove the gavel and instead place one tiny broken balance-scale silhouette against the right edge. No floor, no bottom, no ground plane. Same tall portrait framing. Center remains almost black and open. This is a simple old-school pixel-art background, same visual density and exact pixel size as the input, NOT detailed fantasy concept art. No text or UI.
